he_allocation.selector: classes 1-4: query instance = sel mod (#instances of the class, in manifest order); vector = (sel >> 15) mod (#vectors of the source). class 5: instance = sel mod (#pairs x 50), enumerated pair-major (pair p, sweep point i) -> p * 50 + i, sweep points u-major in the order of 5_sweep.u x 5_sweep.v; the vector is that sweep point

source_codes.0: class 5 only: its own sweep vector (no other source)
source_codes.1: b later refit (falls back to c if none)

normalized_coordinates:
in NORMALIZED family coordinates (u, v): theta = th_lo + u (th_hi - th_lo),
beta = b_lo + v (b_hi - b_lo), with the family of that dataset / position / family rule. The family is centred on the
reference, so (0.5, 0.5) is the reference. Out-of-family draws use u, v in [-1, 2] (= +-3 half-widths around the
reference) with rejection of points inside [0, 1]^2.
